intent: Improve Nemotron AppNest contract compliance and measure against GLM without weakening validation
screeningOrder: Sequential fresh checkpoints, baseline then bounded-reasoning then contract-reasoning; no overlapping evaluator invocations
fullPhase: At most one fresh 36-case run for the selected candidate plus contemporaneous GLM control, concurrency2; no claims of parity without complete category coverage
stopConditions: Existing auth/quota/nonzero reported cost/HTTP202 behavior stops or blocks the evaluator; do not auto-resume
If a screening profile returns only availability failures on its first operation, stop that profile and exclude it; record any interrupted dispatch outcome as unknown
No automatic credit purchase or paid fallback
scope: Synthetic saved responses; no private records
Default configured application model and transport remain unchanged
One exploratory adaptive selection trial, no statistical or universal parity claim
Do not reinterpret or overwrite historical checkpoints
